_comment: Example only. The agent writes digests/<D>/_parts/radar_inputs.json every day from that day's trend_keywords.json and X keyword table. Keywords must exist in those lists and appear in hook_en or angle. 5-8 ideas, every idea has a visual (no text-only posts); 2-3 article ideas. No invented facts: 'why' cites real board posts / views.

ideas.title: One prompt-injection test you can run in 60 seconds
ideas.visual: Screen recording: paste a poisoned README into your agent, show it trying to follow the hidden line, then show the fix.
ideas.angle: Practical prompt injection check for anyone running agents on their own repos.
ideas.hook_en: Your agent reads every README you clone. Here is a 60 second prompt injection test before it reads the wrong one.
ideas.why: Two board hits on agent security cleared the floor yesterday (see why-it-hit).
